versions.name: Paws for Water

provenance.notes: Name, rank placement and category from the official rank adventure pages. The evergreen description is original prose regenerated from the adventure's own 'Snapshot' section, excluding requirement text.

versions.description: Wolves get wet while learning to swim safely. They practice water rules, enter and exit the swimming area properly, attempt a stroke, and jump feet first into water that is chest deep or deeper.
